masterArtDirection: Editorial still-life photograph for a therapist brand identity. Warm late-afternoon directional light from the upper left, soft believable contact shadows, gentle vignette, fine film grain. Palette: terracotta #B4653F, ochre #C8912E, cream #F3EDE3, warm paper #FBF8F3, warm ink #26211C — never pink, never pastel sage or lavender. Uncoated paper with visible fiber, matte surfaces, linen, ceramic. No people, no faces, no hands. No lotus flowers, brains, puzzle pieces, meditation imagery. No visible text except at most the single word FIELDNOTE as a small letterpress wordmark where the shot brief says so. No testimonials, ratings, or awards. Calm, precise, expensive; the opposite of a wellness template.

presets.flatlay: Overhead flat-lay on warm cream: two thick uncoated business cards slightly offset (one terracotta, one cream with a small FIELDNOTE letterpress wordmark), a folded letterhead corner, a fanned stack of five paper color swatches, a ceramic cup, raking light.
presets.card-macro: Extreme close-up, shallow depth of field: the edge of a thick cream business card with a letterpress FIELDNOTE wordmark catching the light, terracotta card blurred beneath.
presets.desk: Three-quarter view of a therapist's desk corner: closed linen notebook, ceramic lamp warm glow, small terracotta paper stack, a plant shadow on warm plaster wall, no screens.
presets.texture: Abstract full-frame close crop: folded terracotta-tinted paper in raking light, sharp folds, visible fiber. No text at all.
presets.swatch: Overhead: five paper swatch cards fanned like dealt cards on cream, terracotta / ochre / cream / paper white / warm ink, honest paper shadows. No text.
